# AT Consulting LLC

> AT Consulting LLC helps athletic training education programs prepare for and achieve CAATE (Commission on Accreditation of Athletic Training Education) accreditation. We are an independent consulting firm; we are not affiliated with or endorsed by CAATE or the Board of Certification (BOC).

AT Consulting LLC provides consulting services for colleges and universities running athletic training education programs — not individual certification support for practicing/licensed athletic trainers (that is handled separately by the BOC).

## Services

- Self-study report review and preparation
- Mock site visits
- Curriculum mapping against CAATE standards
- Ongoing advisory support through the accreditation cycle

See [services.html](https://atconsultingllc.com/services.html) for full details and [pricing.html](https://atconsultingllc.com/pricing.html) for packages.
